protocol.fixture: 12 files of 100 KiB, two fixed canonical document views, two saved 100 KiB note sessions; same content and layout as full acceptance fixture
protocol.forcedGC: Only after normal baseline, 100 cycles, 60 second settle and normal after measurement

normalBaseline.method: Toolhelp owner + recursive descendants; PSAPI QueryWorkingSet non-shared resident pages; GetProcessMemoryInfo PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX.PrivateUsage; failed child queries count as zero only after a previously opened SYNCHRONIZE handle signals termination
normalBaseline.terminationProof: WaitForSingleObject(handle,0) returns immediately; WAIT_OBJECT_0 proves a process object is signaled, which Microsoft documents as termination. SYNCHRONIZE is sufficient; QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION is not a substitute for wait rights. Failed OpenProcess, including error 87, is not proof and remains invalid. Owner failures always remain invalid.
